mapper.insert: INSERT INTO trip_plans (owner_id, title, description, start_date, end_date) VALUES (#{ownerId}, #{title}, #{description}, #{startDate}, #{endDate})
mapper.select: SELECT id, owner_id, title, description, start_date, end_date, view_count, version, created_at, updated_at FROM trip_plans WHERE id = #{id}
SELECT id, owner_id, title, description, start_date, end_date, view_count, version, created_at, updated_at FROM trip_plans WHERE owner_id = #{ownerId} ORDER BY created_at DESC, id DESC
mapper.update: UPDATE trip_plans SET title = #{plan.title}, description = #{plan.description}, start_date = #{plan.startDate}, end_date = #{plan.endDate}, version = version + 1 WHERE id = #{id} AND version = #{expectedVersion}
